corpus: 384 fresh provider renders, deu_for_eng seeds 1-5, 2026-08-05 naked pass (never trimmed, presumed-good by construction)
syllableMethod: vowel-group counting, per-language vowel sets (German adds aou-umlaut); every word counts at least 1
model: speechMs = intercept + msPerSyllable * syllables, fitted per voice. A flat syllables/sec was fitted first and is kept for reference; the linear model is used because a clip carries fixed onset+release overhead, so a flat rate reads every short clip as slow and every long clip as fast.
